scope: Local assignment HOME tilde expansion, including literal export/readonly declaration operands.
semantics: Recognize unquoted tilde prefixes after the first assignment equals sign and unquoted colon delimiters, terminating at slash, colon or word end. Preserve quote/parameter boundaries. Expand from the environment visible to each assignment without splitting, globbing or reparsing inserted HOME/parameter values. Defer unsupported login-name lookup until actual expansion so conditionally skipped commands stay skipped.
bounds: Retain 8192 transformed fragments, 4096 bytes per variable and existing environment/expanded byte quotas. No persistence format or infrastructure change.

validation.build: Final bun run build passed, followed by final native shell-variables suite.
validation.kernel: 43 tests passed; 85 new exact-stdout native sh oracle comparisons (17 assignment forms across five HOME values). Fragment boundary tests accept 4095 tilde-colon pairs and reject 4096, with empty HOME. Missing HOME and login-name lookup reject explicitly.
validation.oracle: GNU bash 5.3.20 invoked as sh. Includes empty/space/metacharacter HOME, colon lists, quoted/escaped prefixes, quoted prefix terminators and literal parameter contents.
validation.nativeRegression: Five native Alchemy workerd/R2/Queue suites passed: 760 assertions, 13.00 seconds. Includes parameters, control, redirection, readonly and variables.
validation.finalNative: Final rebuilt native shell-variables suite passed: 99 assertions, 4.20 seconds. Final failure assertions distinguish ENOTSUP from EFBIG.
